body_lead: BENGALURU: Upbeat about the potential of artificial intelligence (AI) enhancing efficiency in governance, Revenue Minister Krishna Byregowda on Thursday revealed that soon, his department will be rolling out an AI module that will streamline land transactions and registration processes, while bringing in transparency. Byregowda, who interacted with government officials and leading tech company representatives at the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2024, shared the state government's vision for a tech-driven future, which puts the common man at the centre.
